# Bighorn Painting

> Painting company based in Arvada, Colorado, serving Arvada and the surrounding Adams and Weld County towns. Interior and exterior house painting, cabinet refinishing, deck and fence staining, drywall repair and texture, rental turnovers, HOA and community painting, and commercial and agricultural work. Over 20 years of experience, fully insured, 5-year workmanship warranty.

## Published Colorado cost context

- Exterior house painting: about $1.55 to $4.10 per square foot of paintable surface (2026 published Front Range data)
- Interior painting: about $1.50 to $3.50 per square foot
- Kitchen cabinet refinishing: about $2,000 to $8,000 per kitchen

## Local conditions in Arvada

- Open prairie lots with little tree cover mean strong sun and steady wind on every elevation
- West and south elevations fade and chalk years before the rest of the house
- Irrigation spray on siding is a leading cause of early peeling on larger lots
- Denver-area average last spring freeze about May 5; average first fall freeze about October 7 (National Weather Service)
- Homes built before 1978, common in downtown Arvada, may contain lead paint; the EPA Renovation, Repair and Painting rule applies

## Service area

- Arvada neighborhoods: Olde Town Arvada, Arvada West and Lamar Heights, Candelas, Leyden Rock and West Arvada, Ralston Valley and Ralston Creek, Lake Arbor and Woodrun, Five Parks, Arvada Plaza and East Arvada
- Nearby communities: Wheat Ridge, Westminster, Golden, Broomfield, Lakewood, Northglenn, Thornton, Superior and Louisville
